D019-D005_h001.question:
It’s been going on for a little over six months now, maybe longer. Ever since I got laid off at the plant, I don’t sleep right. I fall asleep okay, but I’m up two, three times a night, staring at the ceiling. Once I’m awake, my brain just starts spinning, and I can’t settle back down.

But what really scares me isn’t about the job. I hear a man’s voice commenting on what I’m doing, like, “You’re useless,” or “They’re watching you,” even when the house is quiet and the TV’s off. D019-D005_h002.question:

D019-D005_h003.question:
